name: freddy-fixit-smoke
description: Nightly browser smoke test against production. Deliberately a SEPARATE package from the repo root so Playwright never enters the app's dependency tree or its lockfile -- .github/workflows/typecheck.yml runs `npm ci`, which refuses when package.json and package-lock.json have drifted, and the owner's local `npm install` must not pull a browser engine it has no use for.
